title: Liberty University (Liberty)
summary: Liberty University (Liberty) is a university in Lynchburg. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with Liberty.

sections.heading: What Liberty is known for
paragraphs: Liberty University (Liberty) is a private nonprofit institution with a large undergraduate enrollment of 50,012 students. The university has a notably high admission rate of approximately 98.98%, reflecting its inclusive admissions policy. Liberty is recognized for its diverse academic offerings, with a significant portion of its programs focused on business and health fields. Specifically, about 18.85% of its programs are in business, while 5.46% are dedicated to health-related disciplines. These program shares highlight Liberty's emphasis on preparing students for careers in these sectors.
